'''Rand''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Infinite Army]], a group of [[Soldier/Legends|supersoldiers]] implanted with [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] technology by the [[Order of Revan]]. Rand commanded soldiers of the Infinite Army in defense of the [[Temple of the Ancients]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] when a group of independent operatives [[Raid on Rakata Prime|invaded the Temple]] during the [[Galactic War]], and he was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in battle.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Rand appears as one of the bosses in the "Legacy of the Rakata" Tactical Flashpoint in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
